excerpt: Compare Sharjah and Ajman family living costs over a year, including rent, school, utilities and commuting.
introduction:
A family comparing Sharjah and Ajman should add the cost of the whole routine, not only rent. The home, school, employer benefits, utility arrangements and distance to work can change the result for each household. Use the same 12-month period and comparable homes, then keep move-in deposits separate.

The budget below is an example for two adults and two children. It is not an average, a current rent or a promise that a school or home is available at those amounts.
takeaways: Compare rent, school, transport, utilities and everyday spending on the same annual basis.
Check actual school fees, insurance cover, utility arrangements and commute costs for the family.
Budget separately for move-in cash, refundable deposits and an emergency reserve.

sections.heading: Build a comparable family budget
sections.body:
In the example below, the sample Sharjah case has AED 60,000 rent, AED 30,000 food, AED 24,000 schooling, AED 16,000 transport and AED 12,000 utilities, totalling AED 142,000. The Ajman case assumes AED 50,000 rent, the same food, school and utility amounts, and AED 24,000 transport, totalling AED 140,000.

The AED 2,000 difference is a result of these assumptions alone. Actual homes, schools, benefits and journeys differ. The table and chart exclude healthcare, leisure, moving, deposits, savings and unexpected costs; add them to a real household budget.

Equal schooling costs are used only to simplify the illustration. Obtain the current schedule and transport quote for each child's actual school.

sections.heading: Check housing and move-in costs
sections.body:
Compare homes with similar bedrooms, condition, parking and included services. Ask for annual rent, payment dates, security deposit, brokerage, lease registration and any move-in charge. A lower rent may not remain lower after utilities and transport.

For Sharjah, the [municipality's residential tenancy template](https://portal.shjmun.gov.ae/en/eservices/Attachements/Residential-Tenancy-Contract-Template.pdf) describes attestation and party obligations. For Ajman, the [residential lease authentication service](https://ajman.ae/en/happiness-bundle/services/establish-business/authentication-lease-contract-residential-purposes) describes the Tasdeeq process. Confirm current charges and responsibilities for each actual contract.

Keep refundable deposits in a separate cash plan, not automatically as an annual expense. Record any deduction when it occurs and retain receipts and the condition report.

sections.heading: Calculate school and transport together
sections.body:
Ask each school for the current fees by grade, registration, books, uniforms, activities and bus service for the exact address. Confirm admission before treating the school as available. An employer allowance should be subtracted only after checking its limit, eligibility and payment timing.

Test the actual school and work routes at relevant times. Add fuel, tolls, parking, vehicle insurance and maintenance or public transport fares. A home farther from work may require a second car or longer school route.

Compare the family's whole week, including journeys by someone without a car. Test each regular journey at the time your household would normally travel.

sections.heading: Verify utilities and healthcare
sections.body:
Ask each landlord who provides electricity, water and cooling, whether the apartment is separately metered and what is included in rent. [Etihad Water and Electricity's tariff page](https://etihadwe.ae/en/About/Pages/Tariff.aspx) lists categories for its services. Confirm the provider and applicable tariff for the specific Ajman home; check the Sharjah provider and account requirements separately.

Review the family's health insurance, premiums, co-payments, network and services not covered. Include regular medication and expected appointments where relevant. Costs vary by policy and household, so obtain the actual terms rather than applying a city-wide average.

Add internet, mobile plans and routine leisure to complete the budget. The table is intentionally a partial example and cannot establish your total cost of living.

sections.heading: Plan payment dates and a reserve
sections.body:
Put rent instalments, school payments, insurance and other large bills on a calendar alongside income. An annual total divided by twelve can conceal a large payment due before salary arrives. Set aside funds in advance and keep an emergency reserve.

Test a higher rent at renewal, an extra school fee and a repair or medical expense. If an employer benefit changes, recalculate both options. The purpose is to see whether the household has flexibility, not to predict every cost precisely.

The [Sharjah family area guide](/journal/best-areas-to-buy-property-in-sharjah-for-families) and [Ajman area guide](/journal/ajman-property-2026) offer location context. Visit the actual homes and verify their terms.

sections.heading: Compare the quality of the routine
sections.body:
Time matters alongside money. Record the weekly work and school journeys, access to family support, outdoor space and the services available to someone without a car. A small difference in the partial budget may be less important than a substantial difference in daily travel or the suitability of the home.

Set the family's non-negotiables before comparing prices. Revisit the budget if the intended school, workplace or number of office days changes.

sections.heading: Check what benefits actually cover
sections.body:
Review the written terms of housing, transport, education and health benefits provided by an employer. Some may have limits, apply only to selected providers or be paid after you incur the expense. Enter a benefit only once and distinguish a reimbursement from a direct payment by the employer.

If a school or home requires a deposit before reimbursement arrives, include that amount in the cash calendar. Compare the two emirates with and without any uncertain allowance. A benefit that changes with employment should not be treated as permanent income when deciding whether a long lease or purchase is affordable.

sections.heading: Ask for current homes and terms
sections.body:
Browse [Aliyas Sharjah projects](/projects?emirate=Sharjah) and [Ajman projects](/projects?emirate=Ajman) for local context. [Contact Aliyas](/contact) with your household needs and ask which relevant homes are currently available.

Request the exact address and written housing terms, then replace every example with your own verified figures.
